title: Finite-free isomorphism for affine model terms
statement: For each integer degree, the transported term of the explicit affine finite-free model is isomorphic to a finite free localized structure-sheaf module when K_n is finite free.

source.place: Tag 068C, affine finite free resolution argument

proof.text: Unfold the model and split according to whether the integer degree is in the image of embeddingDownNat. In the image, extendXIso identifies the extended term with the corresponding sheafified module. Outside the image, isZero_extend_X makes it zero.
For an in-range term, use Module.Free.chooseBasis and ChooseBasisIndex.fintype, reindex the finite basis by ULift (Fin m), and map its repr.toModuleIso through tilde. Compose with tildeFinsupp.

Restriction is a left adjoint (restrictAdjunction), and the inverse overEquiv is an equivalence, so both preserve coproducts. Apply mapFreeIso to restrictUnitIso and sheafOfModulesEquivOverInverseUnit, and compose the mapped isomorphisms.

Outside the embedding image, map_isZero transports zero through the inverse equivalence. The free sheaf on ULift (Fin 0) is zero: Sigma.hom_ext proves its identity equals zero, since there are no indices. IsZero.iso finishes.

theorem affine_finite_free_model_term_iso_free {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U) : Type u)) ℕ)
    (hfree : ∀ n, Module.Free (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) (K.X n))
    (hfinite : ∀ n, Module.Finite (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) (K.X n)) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, Nonempty ((affineFiniteFreeModelComplex U hU K).X n ≅
      SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
